name: Para Para
source:
Main character fails during his first experience with childhood friend Ringo. It was Ringo's mother Momoko who helped him during this depressing time. The relationship becomes more and more awkward as physical relations with Momoko continue at the same time that protagonist dates Ringo.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与青梅竹马凛子第一次发生关系时失败了。是凛子的母亲桃子帮助他度过了这段低落时期。随着主人公继续与桃子保持肉体关系，同时又和凛子交往，两人的关系变得越来越尴尬。

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]）
